item.buckets_update.bucket.water_only: This bucket can only hold water
advancements.buckets_update.root.title: Bucketry
advancements.buckets_update.root.descrip: Welcome to your first bucket adventure. Choose your path: wood, bamboo, copper, or iron.
advancements.buckets_update.splash.title: Splish Splash
advancements.buckets_update.splash.descr: Fill a bucket with water — wood, bamboo or copper.
advancements.buckets_update.old_school.d: Craft an iron bucket — using the revised recipe.
advancements.buckets_update.craft_wooden: Craft a wooden bucket: 5 planks in a V. Lightweight but breaks after ~16 uses.
advancements.buckets_update.craft_copper: Craft a copper bucket: 5 copper ingots in a V. Mid-tier durability — outlasts wood, eventually breaks.
advancements.buckets_update.craft_bamboo: Craft a bamboo bucket: 5 bamboo planks in a V. Twice as tough as wood — ~32 uses.
advancements.buckets_update.udder_master: Milk a cow into a wooden, bamboo or copper bucket.
advancements.buckets_update.last_drop.de: Drink down a milk bucket — wood, bamboo or copper.
advancements.buckets_update.craft_gold.d: Craft a gold bucket: 5 gold ingots in a V. Carries water, lava, milk, and powder snow — 32 uses.
enchantment.buckets_update.fluid_infinit: Places liquids using experience points instead of emptying the bucket.
enchantment.buckets_update.thermal_shiel: Grants passive Fire Resistance when holding a lava bucket.
Chance to place liquids without consuming them.
